risk_notes.text: Product labelling warns that immunosuppression may increase susceptibility to infection and possible development of lymphoma and other malignancies; other labelled risks include impaired wound healing, hyperlipidemia and proteinuria. Labelled safety data come from transplant and LAM patients, not longevity dosing.

arbitrage_summary.text: Mexico: sirolimus is marketed as a prescription transplant drug; longevity use would be off-label; current COFEPRIS registration and off-label rules not verified.
